description_en: Queries the information about the servers whose Security Center agent status is Offline
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-offline-machines --source-ip 180.113.XX.XX --page-size 5 --current-page 4 --region-no cn-hangzhou --os linux --remark 172.20.XX.XX --vendor 0 --region-id-str cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeOfflineMachines

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的备份文件的数量。默认值为5，表示每页显示5条备份文件
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the server resides.

The value of this parameter is the value of the Values parameter that is returned by calling the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation. If the value of the Name parameter in the response is regionId, the value of the Values parameter indicates a region ID
parameters.help_zh:
服务器所在的地域。

您可以调用[DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~)接口通过Name为regionId的项的Values来获取支持的地域
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the server.

The value of this parameter is the value of the Values parameter that is returned by calling the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation. If the value of the Name parameter in the response is osType, the value of the Values parameter indicates an operating system
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统。
您可以调用[DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~)接口通过Name为osType的项的Values来获取支持的操作系统
parameters.name: os

parameters.help_en: The information about the server that you want to query. The value can be the name or the public IP address of the server
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的资产信息，可以设置为资产名称、公网IP
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The source of the server. Valid values:

0: an asset provided by Alibaba Cloud.
1: a third-party cloud server
2: a server in a data center
3, 4, 5, and 7: other cloud asset
8: a lightweight asset
parameters.help_zh:
服务器厂商。取值：

0：阿里云资产
1：云外资产
2：IDC资产
3、4、5、7：其它云资产
8：轻量级资产
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the server resides.

The value of this parameter is the value of the Values parameter that is returned by calling the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation. If the value of the Name parameter in the response is regionId, the value of the Values parameter indicates a region ID
parameters.help_zh:
服务器所在的地域。

您可以调用[DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~)接口通过Name为regionId的项的Values来获取支持的地域
parameters.name: region_id_str

CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码
